IMPLEMENT THIS FEATURE END-TO-END, NOT JUST AN AUDIT.

Build an insane selectable race-track environment for the BMW M5 driving lab, as a complete self-contained implementation from current main.

Non-negotiable requirements:
- DEFAULT launch/spawn stays the current empty plane. The new track is opt-in from the start menu only.
- Add a clean environment/mode selector in the start menu and a correct track-specific spawn when selected.
- Isolate/unload track content when plane mode is selected.
- Preserve current vehicle physics; obey AGENTS.md, PHYSICS_CONVENTIONS.md, and M5_VALIDATION.md.
- Keep build + strict validation gates passing.

Creative direction B — outrageous modern showcase circuit:
Design a visually unforgettable fictional circuit that still drives like a serious performance-car track: huge elevation changes, an uphill crest, banked high-speed bowl, skyline-scale overpass, hairpin around a landmark, canyon/coastal-style retaining walls, sweeping esses, a tunnel/covered section, bridge crossover, dramatic start/finish straight, high-quality curbs/runoff/barriers, marshal/braking markers, lighting/gantries, sparse grandstands and structural silhouettes. Think premium manufacturer proving-ground meets world-class street/GP spectacle, but generated procedurally with Three.js and no external model dependency.

Technical expectations:
- Inspect existing code first and work with its ground/raycast/render architecture.
- Create modular reusable track geometry and environment code, not one giant App.tsx blob.
- Generate a continuous, wide, clearly driveable asphalt ribbon that follows route and elevation; prevent obvious gaps/twists at sharp bends.
- Make scene dressing efficient with shared geometry/materials/instancing where useful.
- Plane mode must remain fast and visually unchanged.
- Track mode should have a deliberate start grid and orientation.
- Do not invent a new physics engine; make collision/ground support compatible with the existing one.
- Keep mobile/web performance in mind.
- Patch must build and validate independently.

Return the complete code patch implementing the feature.
